entries.en: The last batch went south. What are they looking for?
We're picking up a comm signal. It's weak, but there's definitely someone out here.
Got some kind of comm signal. It's too weak to pinpoint, but someone is definitely out here.
We are receiving a weak comm signal. I cannot pinpoint its location through the geth interference.
I'm picking up a comm signal. It's too weak to pinpoint, but there's definitely someone out here.

More on the comm, Commander, but I still can't get a fix on it.
More communication, Commander, but I am still unable to pinpoint its origin.
More chatter, Commander. Still no fix.
More chatter incoming, Commander. Still no fix.
Any sign of movement? Lizbeth could still be in there. It's only been a few days.
She's my daughter. I'll wait as long as I have to.
We've got movement... some kind of vehicle. Not one of the geth.
They've got us on visual. We must be close.
They're not our concern. We need to find those geth.

Forget them. We need to deal with the geth.
We should deal with the geth first.
Dealing with the geth is more important.
They've seen us. They must be nearby.
Sounds like they've spotted us. They must be close.
They must be close enough to see us.
Whoever that is, they must be close to have seen us.

We seem to have alarmed them.
We seem to have caused some concern.
That got their attention.
Sounds like that got their attention.
Well, we won't be surprising them.
